description: Transportation simplex matching: Maintain tree basis and dual node potentials on bipartite network.
Pivot into basis nonbasic edge with most negative reduced cost; adjust flow along fundamental cycle.
Apply Bland's anti-cycling rule upon repeated degenerate pivots.
